name: automation-workflows
description: Automation workflow skills for browser operation, web access, OpenCLI command discovery, adapter authoring, and autofix workflows.

interface.shortDescription: 用于浏览器、联网、CLI 与适配器自动化流程的技能集。
interface.longDescription: Automation Workflows packages OpenCLI agent skills and eze-is/web-access for Codex. It helps agents discover OpenCLI commands, drive logged-in browser sessions, choose web access strategies, operate CDP browser tabs, accumulate site experience, create reusable site adapters, and repair broken adapters with trace-guided autofix workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use opencli-usage to find the right OpenCLI command for this task.
Use web-access to handle this web research or browser automation task.
Use opencli-adapter-author to create and verify a new OpenCLI adapter.
